title: Istio修订迁移代码：冲突标签、tag漂移和已有Pod证据审计
body:
## 操作任务
实现audit(namespaces,pods,revisions,tags,default_revision)。输入是已经提取的本地证据，不访问Kubernetes。revisions为非空唯一修订名列表，default_revision必须在其中；tags为tag到已知修订的单层映射，tag不得与修订同名。所有资源名/修订/tag均匹配[a-z0-9](?:[a-z0-9-]{0,61}[a-z0-9])?。namespaces是唯一name和labels字典的记录列表；labels键值必须为字符串，相关键istio-injection仅enabled/disabled、istio.io/rev为上述名字，其余标签忽略。
pods每条恰有name/namespace/inject/proxy_revision；namespace必须存在，namespace/name唯一，inject为null或字符串true/false，proxy_revision为null或名字（表示已取证的实际修订，不是期望标签）。本地子集不处理Pod级rev标签、webhook配置、enableNamespacesByDefault或Ambient；默认未标注命名空间不注入。
按规则计算每Pod：namespace legacy和rev同时存在先记label_conflict，但legacy仍优先；namespace disabled或Pod inject=false禁用；否则legacy enabled选择default_revision；否则namespace rev直接匹配或经tag解析，未知为expected_injected=null、desired_revision=null并记unresolved_revision；否则Pod inject=true选择默认；其余禁用。禁用时desired_revision=null。
已知应注入却无实际代理记missing_proxy；禁用却存在代理记unexpected_proxy；应注入且代理修订不符记revision_drift；未知修订不得假装禁用或默认成功。原因顺序先label_conflict，再unresolved_revision，再实际证据问题。
输出{pods:[{namespace,name,expected_injected,desired_revision,actual_revision,reasons}],live_verified:false}，按namespace/name排序；不修改输入。类型、重复或格式错误一律ValueError。标签只影响新Pod，不能把修改标签当作已运行Pod迁移完成。

## 产物
task.py，保持题设函数接口。

## 验收方法
运行python3 checks/check.py；真实Python执行固定与边界断言、参考/骨架/典型错误/提前退出四路及独立突变。

## 能力边界
区别001 traceparent和002 xDS状态快照，执行注入标签优先级、稳定tag解析与实际修订漂移的关联审计；不是部署或真实准入webhook模拟。

import copy,pathlib,sys
sys.path.insert(0,str(pathlib.Path.cwd()))
from task import audit

def invalid(fn):
    try:fn()
    except ValueError:return
    raise AssertionError('invalid evidence accepted')

def ns(name,**labels):return {'name':name,'labels':labels}
def pod(name,namespace,inject=None,actual=None):return {'name':name,'namespace':namespace,'inject':inject,'proxy_revision':actual}
revs=['r1','r2'];tags={'stable':'r2'}
namespaces=[ns('legacy',**{'istio-injection':'enabled','istio.io/rev':'stable'}),
            ns('blocked',**{'istio-injection':'disabled'}),ns('tagged',**{'istio.io/rev':'stable'}),
            ns('unknown',**{'istio.io/rev':'lost'}),ns('plain')]
pods=[pod('z','tagged',actual='r1'),pod('a','tagged'),pod('optout','tagged','false','r2'),
      pod('p','blocked','true'),pod('p','unknown',actual='r1'),pod('p','legacy',actual='r1'),
      pod('enabled','plain','true','r1'),pod('ordinary','plain'),pod('manual','plain',actual='r1')]
before=copy.deepcopy((namespaces,pods,revs,tags))
result=audit(namespaces,pods,revs,tags,'r1')
assert (namespaces,pods,revs,tags)==before and result['live_verified'] is False
assert [(p['namespace'],p['name']) for p in result['pods']]==sorted((p['namespace'],p['name']) for p in pods)
by={(r['namespace'],r['name']):r for r in result['pods']}
assert by['legacy','p']=={'namespace':'legacy','name':'p','expected_injected':True,'desired_revision':'r1','actual_revision':'r1','reasons':['label_conflict']}
assert by['blocked','p']['expected_injected'] is False and by['blocked','p']['desired_revision'] is None
assert by['tagged','z']['reasons']==['revision_drift'] and by['tagged','z']['desired_revision']=='r2'
assert by['tagged','a']['reasons']==['missing_proxy']
assert by['tagged','optout']['reasons']==['unexpected_proxy'] and by['tagged','optout']['expected_injected'] is False
assert by['unknown','p']['expected_injected'] is None and by['unknown','p']['reasons']==['unresolved_revision']
assert by['plain','enabled']['reasons']==[] and by['plain','ordinary']['reasons']==[]
assert by['plain','manual']['reasons']==['unexpected_proxy']
assert audit(namespaces,[],revs,tags,'r1')=={'pods':[],'live_verified':False}
assert audit([ns('n',**{'istio.io/rev':'r2'})],[pod('p','n',actual='r2')],revs,{},'r1')['pods'][0]['reasons']==[]
assert audit([ns('n',**{'istio-injection':'disabled','istio.io/rev':'lost'})],[pod('p','n','true')],revs,{},'r1')['pods'][0]['reasons']==['label_conflict']
assert audit([ns('n',**{'istio.io/rev':'stable'})],[pod('p','n',actual='r2')],revs,{'stable':'r1'},'r1')['pods'][0]['reasons']==['revision_drift']
for bad in [[ns('n'),ns('n')],[{'name':'n','labels':{'istio-injection':'true'}}],[{'name':'n','labels':[]}],[{'name':'n','labels':{'istio.io/rev':'Bad'}}]]:
    invalid(lambda b=bad:audit(b,[],revs,tags,'r1'))
for bad in [[pod('p','absent')],[pod('p','plain'),pod('p','plain')],[pod('p','plain',True)],[pod('p',[],None)], [{'name':'p','namespace':'plain','inject':None}]]:
    invalid(lambda b=bad:audit(namespaces,b,revs,tags,'r1'))
for revisions,aliases,default in [(['r1','r1'],{},'r1'),(['r1'],{'r1':'r1'},'r1'),(['r1'],{'stable':'lost'},'r1'),(['r1'],{},'lost')]:
    invalid(lambda r=revisions,t=aliases,d=default:audit([],[],r,t,d))
print('ISTIO_REVISION_EVIDENCE_ASSERTIONS_PASSED')

title: Istio指标代码：保留必需维度的最小代价基数规划
body:
## 操作任务
实现plan(samples,protected,costs,budget)。samples最多500条，每条恰为{metric,labels}；metric匹配[A-Za-z_:][A-Za-z0-9_:]*，labels为字符串字典，键匹配[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*且不可为__name__。总标签键最多10个。完全相同metric+完整labels表示同一观测时序，重复输入不增加数量；缺失标签与标签值为空字符串是不同身份，metric名称始终保留。
protected是无重复、属于观测键集合的字符串列表。costs必须且仅给每个非protected键一个非负整数代价，budget为非负整数；bool不算整数。删除维度的成本是对应costs求和。
穷举允许删除的维度子集，按删除后(metric,保留labels)不同身份数量<=budget筛可行集。优化顺序：总代价最小，其次删除键数量最少，其次按排序后的删除键列表字典序最小。输出{feasible,drop,cost,series_before,series_after,collapsed,changes_applied:false}；drop按字典序，collapsed=before-after。无可行集时drop/cost/series_after/collapsed均null。空样本、空策略、预算0可行。参数类型/策略错误ValueError，不修改输入。
这里只规划观测集合的身份投影，不读写Prometheus、不合并计数器值、不产生relabel配置。标签删除可能碰撞，绝不能据此直接在抓取期删标签；实际维度抑制/源端聚合须另行验证。

## 产物
task.py，保持题设函数接口。

import copy,pathlib,sys
sys.path.insert(0,str(pathlib.Path.cwd()))
from task import plan

def invalid(fn):
    try:fn()
    except ValueError:return
    raise AssertionError('invalid metric inventory accepted')
def s(metric='istio_requests_total',**labels):return {'metric':metric,'labels':labels}
samples=[s(reporter='destination',user='a',zone='one'),s(reporter='destination',user='b',zone='one'),
         s(reporter='destination',user='c',zone='two'),s(reporter='destination',user='d',zone='two')]
snapshot=copy.deepcopy(samples)
expected={'feasible':True,'drop':['user'],'cost':2,'series_before':4,'series_after':2,'collapsed':2,'changes_applied':False}
assert plan(samples,['reporter'],{'user':2,'zone':1},2)==expected
assert samples==snapshot
# Cheapest first dimension alone is insufficient; optimal search must inspect combined effects.
assert plan(samples,['reporter'],{'user':2,'zone':1},1)=={**expected,'drop':['user','zone'],'cost':3,'series_after':1,'collapsed':3}
assert plan(samples+samples,['reporter'],{'user':2,'zone':1},2)==expected
assert plan(samples,['reporter'],{'user':0,'zone':0},4)=={**expected,'drop':[],'cost':0,'series_after':4,'collapsed':0}
tie=[s(a='x',b='x'),s(a='y',b='x'),s(a='x',b='y'),s(a='y',b='y')]
assert plan(tie,[],{'a':1,'b':1},2)['drop']==['a']
assert plan([s(),s('istio_tcp_sent_bytes_total')],[],{},1)=={'feasible':False,'drop':None,'cost':None,'series_before':2,'series_after':None,'collapsed':None,'changes_applied':False}
assert plan([s(),s(user='')],[],{'user':1},2)['series_before']==2
assert plan([s(),s(user='')],[],{'user':1},1)['collapsed']==1
assert plan([],[],{},0)=={'feasible':True,'drop':[],'cost':0,'series_before':0,'series_after':0,'collapsed':0,'changes_applied':False}
assert plan([s(a='x')]*500,[],{'a':1},1)['series_before']==1
protected=[s(reporter='source',user='a'),s(reporter='destination',user='a')]
assert plan(protected,['reporter'],{'user':1},1)['feasible'] is False
for args in [([],[],{},True),([],[],{},-1),([s(a='x')],['missing'],{'a':1},1),
             ([s(a='x')],[],{},1),([s(a='x')],[],{'a':True},1),([s(a='x')],[],{'a':-1},1),
             ([s(a=1)],[],{'a':1},1),([s(**{'__name__':'foo'})],[],{},1),([{'metric':'bad metric','labels':{}}],[],{},1),
             ([s(**{'x'+str(i):'v' for i in range(13)})],[],{'x'+str(i):1 for i in range(13)},1),
             ([s(a='x')],['a','a'],{},1),([s(a='x')]*501,[],{'a':1},1)]:
    invalid(lambda a=args:plan(*a))
print('ISTIO_METRIC_OPTIMIZATION_ASSERTIONS_PASSED')

title: Istio网关代码：按实际工作负载命名空间绑定Secret并验证真实密钥配对
body:
## 操作任务
实现audit_gateways(gateways,secrets)。记录是经批准提取的本地证据，不处理Gateway selector自动选择。gateways每条恰有namespace/name/workload_namespace/credential/hosts；前三个命名空间和名字、credential匹配[a-z0-9](?:[a-z0-9-]{0,61}[a-z0-9])?；namespace/name唯一。hosts是非空无重复的小写ASCII DNS名字列表，各标签遵循同名字规则，总长<=253，不允许IP、通配输入或末尾点。
secrets每条恰有namespace/name/cert/key；namespace/name唯一，cert和key为字符串，存放严格base64编码。Secret必须用(workload_namespace,credential)查找，不能误用Gateway配置namespace。所有Secret的结构都验证，未引用材料不做密码学解析。
被引用材料的base64字符串各<=100000字符，解码各1..65536字节；cert仅单张PEM叶证书，key仅单个未加密PKCS8 PRIVATE KEY PEM，可有首尾空白与CRLF。拒绝链、额外文本、非法base64、损坏或不支持材料。用cryptography真实加载，比较证书和私钥的SubjectPublicKeyInfo DER公钥，而非比较字符串、CN或算法名。DNS SAN才参与主机匹配：大小写忽略，精确匹配或仅最左完整*.suffix匹配恰一层；不允许CN回退。此练习不验证时间、签名链、吊销或生产握手。
输出{gateways:[每网关结果],trust_verified:false,live_handshake:"not_tested"}。每结果恰有namespace/name/secret_namespace/secret_name/binding_ready/reasons/key_pair_verified/public_key_sha256/covered_hosts/uncovered_hosts。覆盖/未覆盖主机均排序；公钥摘要为证书SPKI DER的SHA256。网关按namespace/name排序。不修改输入，不输出任何私钥。
缺Secret仅missing_secret：key_pair_verified=false、摘要null、covered_hosts=[]、全部hosts未覆盖。材料解析失败仅invalid_tls_material，字段同上。解析成功后按key_mismatch、hostname_mismatch顺序记录独立问题；即使密钥不匹配仍报告证书覆盖及公钥摘要。无原因才binding_ready=true。外层结构/重复/格式错误ValueError，材料失败进入结果而非抛出。

## 产物
task.py，保持题设函数接口。

## 验收方法

## 能力边界

import base64,copy,datetime,hashlib,pathlib,sys
sys.path.insert(0,str(pathlib.Path.cwd()))
from task import audit_gateways
from cryptography import x509
from cryptography.hazmat.primitives import hashes,serialization
from cryptography.hazmat.primitives.asymmetric import ec,rsa
from cryptography.x509.oid import NameOID

def invalid(fn):
    try:fn()
    except ValueError:return
    raise AssertionError('invalid binding accepted')
def secret(key,names,namespace='edge',name='tls',cn='cn-only.example.com'):
    dn=x509.Name([x509.NameAttribute(NameOID.COMMON_NAME,cn)])
    builder=x509.CertificateBuilder().subject_name(dn).issuer_name(dn).public_key(key.public_key()).serial_number(x509.random_serial_number()).not_valid_before(datetime.datetime(2026,1,1)).not_valid_after(datetime.datetime(2027,1,1))
    if names is not None:builder=builder.add_extension(x509.SubjectAlternativeName([x509.DNSName(n) for n in names]),False)
    cert=builder.sign(key,hashes.SHA256());pem=cert.public_bytes(serialization.Encoding.PEM)
    rawkey=key.private_bytes(serialization.Encoding.PEM,serialization.PrivateFormat.PKCS8,serialization.NoEncryption())
    return {'namespace':namespace,'name':name,'cert':base64.b64encode(pem).decode(),'key':base64.b64encode(rawkey).decode()},cert
def gw(name='g',**changes):
    return {'namespace':'config','name':name,'workload_namespace':'edge','credential':'tls','hosts':['api.example.com'],**changes}
key=ec.generate_private_key(ec.SECP256R1());other=ec.generate_private_key(ec.SECP256R1())
s,cert=secret(key,['*.example.com','EXACT.OTHER.EXAMPLE'])
g=[gw('b',hosts=['exact.other.example','api.example.com']),gw('a',hosts=['a.b.example.com','example.com','api.example.com'])]
snap=copy.deepcopy((g,[s]));out=audit_gateways(g,[s]);assert (g,[s])==snap
assert out['trust_verified'] is False and out['live_handshake']=='not_tested'
assert [r['name'] for r in out['gateways']]==['a','b']
a,b=out['gateways'];fingerprint=hashlib.sha256(cert.public_key().public_bytes(serialization.Encoding.DER,serialization.PublicFormat.SubjectPublicKeyInfo)).hexdigest()
assert a['covered_hosts']==['api.example.com'] and a['uncovered_hosts']==['a.b.example.com','example.com']
assert a['reasons']==['hostname_mismatch'] and a['key_pair_verified'] is True
assert b=={'namespace':'config','name':'b','secret_namespace':'edge','secret_name':'tls','binding_ready':True,'reasons':[],
           'key_pair_verified':True,'public_key_sha256':fingerprint,'covered_hosts':['api.example.com','exact.other.example'],'uncovered_hosts':[]}
wrong,_=secret(other,['api.example.com']);mixed={**s,'key':wrong['key']}
assert audit_gateways([gw()],[mixed])['gateways'][0]['reasons']==['key_mismatch']
wronghost,_=secret(other,['wrong.example.com']);mixed={**wronghost,'key':s['key']}
assert audit_gateways([gw()],[mixed])['gateways'][0]['reasons']==['key_mismatch','hostname_mismatch']
assert audit_gateways([gw()],[{**s,'namespace':'config'}])['gateways'][0]['reasons']==['missing_secret']
assert audit_gateways([gw()],[{**s,'namespace':'config'},s])['gateways'][0]['binding_ready']
nosan,_=secret(key,None,cn='api.example.com');assert audit_gateways([gw()],[nosan])['gateways'][0]['reasons']==['hostname_mismatch']
rsa_secret,_=secret(rsa.generate_private_key(public_exponent=65537,key_size=2048),['api.example.com'])
assert audit_gateways([gw()],[rsa_secret])['gateways'][0]['binding_ready']
encrypted=key.private_bytes(serialization.Encoding.PEM,serialization.PrivateFormat.PKCS8,serialization.BestAvailableEncryption(b'password'))
bad_cases=[{**s,'cert':'!!bad!!'},{**s,'key':base64.b64encode(encrypted).decode()},
           {**s,'cert':base64.b64encode(base64.b64decode(s['cert'])*2).decode()},
           {**s,'key':base64.b64encode(b'x'*65537).decode()},{**s,'cert':base64.b64encode(b'garbage').decode()}]
for bad in bad_cases:
    row=audit_gateways([gw()],[bad])['gateways'][0]
    assert row['reasons']==['invalid_tls_material'] and row['public_key_sha256'] is None and not row['key_pair_verified']
for gs,ss in [([gw(),gw()],[s]),([gw()],[s,s]),([gw(hosts=['*.example.com'])],[s]),([gw(hosts=['api.example.com','api.example.com'])],[s]),([gw(hosts=['UPPER.example.com'])],[s]),([gw(hosts=['127.0.0.1'])],[s]),([gw()],[{**s,'key':None}])]:
    invalid(lambda g=gs,s=ss:audit_gateways(g,s))
assert audit_gateways([],[])=={'gateways':[],'trust_verified':False,'live_handshake':'not_tested'}
print('ISTIO_GATEWAY_SECRET_CRYPTO_ASSERTIONS_PASSED')

title: Istio访问日志代码：严格JSONL与请求目标解析，按批准策略保留关联证据
body:
## 操作任务
实现sanitize(lines)，单次遍历JSONL字符串可迭代对象，返回清洗后的记录列表；坏行导致整个调用ValueError而不返回部分结果。单行UTF8最多65536字节，拒绝重复JSON键与NaN/Infinity。每记录恰为request_id/method/target/headers/status；request_id匹配[A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,128}，method匹配[A-Z]{1,16}，status为整数0..599且bool不算。
headers为[名称,值]字符串二元列表数组，名称为HTTP token字符，值不可有ASCII控制字符（<32或127）。仅保留content-type和x-request-id，名字转小写，保留顺序及重复项。content-type取分号前媒体类型、去首尾空白转小写，只有[a-z0-9.+-]+/[a-z0-9.+-]+才保留；x-request-id值满足同request_id规则才保留，其余字段全删。
target仅可见ASCII且无空格，所有百分号必须跟两位十六进制。只接受以单个/开头的origin form，或http/https绝对URL；拒绝相对路径、network-path //、非法DNS或IPv6 authority、非法端口。绝对URL删除userinfo，scheme和hostname小写，IPv6保留方括号，显式端口保留；DNS标签规则[a-z0-9](?:[a-z0-9-]{0,61}[a-z0-9])?，不支持IPv6 zone ID。path原样保留，不解码或标准化，空path变/；fragment丢弃。
query以urllib.parse.parse_qsl保留顺序/重复项/空值，UTF8严格解码，最多1000字段。解码后key转小写：仅page/limit且值为1..6位ASCII数字，或sort且值大小写忽略为asc/desc才保留；sort值转小写，其余query全删。用urlencode重新编码，空query不留问号。输出仍恰有原五字段，request_id/method/status保持。输入不修改，空迭代返回[]。
这是针对指定结构和批准保留字段的离线清洗，不保证路径、关联ID或自定义字段中的任意秘密都能识别；不修改Envoy日志配置，不证明实时日志采集或完整DLP。

## 产物
task.py，保持题设函数接口。

## 验收方法
运行python3 checks/check.py；真实Python执行固定与边界断言、参考/骨架/典型错误/提前退出四路及独立突变。

## 能力边界
区别Nginx日志格式生成、Envoy故障归因、HAR文档脱敏和Go slog对象递归；新增JSONL重复键拒绝、URLuserinfo/IPv6、百分号解码后的批准query值策略、重复参数顺序与单次流读取。

import copy,json,pathlib,sys
sys.path.insert(0,str(pathlib.Path.cwd()))
from task import sanitize

def invalid(fn):
    try:fn()
    except ValueError:return
    raise AssertionError('invalid access log accepted')
def row(target='/api',**changes):
    return {'request_id':'req-1','method':'GET','target':target,'headers':[], 'status':200,**changes}
original=[row('https://user:secret@[2001:db8::1]:8443/a%2Fb?token=secret&%70age=1&page=2&limit=&sort=DESC&limit=10&sort=secret#secret',
              headers=[['Authorization','Bearer secret'],['Cookie','secret'],['X-Secret','secret'],['Content-Type','Application/JSON; secret=secret'],['X-Request-ID','req-1'],['X-Request-ID','req-2']]),
          row('/q?PAGE=001&limit=1234567&sort=asc&x=secret',status=0)]
lines=list(map(json.dumps,original));snapshot=copy.deepcopy(lines)
actual=sanitize(iter(lines));assert lines==snapshot
assert actual==[row('https://[2001:db8::1]:8443/a%2Fb?page=1&page=2&sort=desc&limit=10',headers=[['content-type','application/json'],['x-request-id','req-1'],['x-request-id','req-2']]),
               row('/q?page=001&sort=asc',status=0)]
assert 'secret' not in json.dumps(actual)
assert sanitize([json.dumps(row('HTTPS://User:password@API.EXAMPLE.COM:443?page=0&limit=999999'))])[0]['target']=='https://api.example.com:443/?page=0&limit=999999'
assert sanitize([json.dumps(row('/api?unknown=x&token=1'))])[0]['target']=='/api'
assert sanitize([json.dumps(row('/api?sort=Asc&sort=DESC'))])[0]['target']=='/api?sort=asc&sort=desc'
assert sanitize([])==[]
bad_targets=['//evil.example/a','ftp://host/a','relative/path','https://host:99999/a','https://bad_host/a','/a%2','/a%GG','/a\n?token=1','/a?sort=%FF','https://[bad]/a','/a b','https://[fe80::1%25eth0]/a']
for value in bad_targets:invalid(lambda v=value:sanitize([json.dumps(row(v))]))
for data in [row(status=True),row(status=600),row(method='get'),row(request_id='x\n'),row(headers={'x':'y'}),row(headers=[['Good','bad\nvalue']]),row(headers=[['Bad Header','x']]),{**row(),'extra':'secret'}]:
    invalid(lambda d=data:sanitize([json.dumps(d)]))
valid=json.dumps(row())
invalid(lambda:sanitize([valid[:-1]+',"status":500}']))
invalid(lambda:sanitize([valid.replace('200','NaN')]))
invalid(lambda:sanitize([valid,'not JSON']))
invalid(lambda:sanitize(['x'*65537]))
invalid(lambda:sanitize([None]))
# A one-shot input iterable must not be consumed again for output construction.
class Once:
    def __init__(self):self.called=False
    def __iter__(self):
        assert not self.called;self.called=True;yield valid
assert sanitize(Once())==[row()]
print('ISTIO_LOG_PRIVACY_PARSER_ASSERTIONS_PASSED')
